name: Gristlefrost

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The gristlefrost makes three Rimefang attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Frostbound Gaze.

Actions.name: Rimefang
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage.

Actions.name: Frostbound Gaze
Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 17, one creature the gristlefrost can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 13 (3d8) Cold damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.minorClause: , and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the gristlefrost takes the Hide action.

Traits.name: Vile Appearance
Traits.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 17, any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the gristlefrost and can see it. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this creature's gaze for 24 hours.
Traits.expresses: cold that paralyzes with fear, rooting prey so it cannot flee
Traits.expressedQuote: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn.

lore: Born where a blizzard froze a dying winter spirit into the glacier's heart, the Gristlefrost takes no food, only warmth, freezing its victims into silent companions within its killing cold.

generation.userConcept: a frost-thing whose cold makes you too frightened to run
